methods.name: public Builder setScheme(UUID scheme)
methods.comment: Sets the {@link UUID} of the protection scheme.

methods.name: private Builder setNullableScheme(@Nullable UUID scheme)
methods.comment:
* @deprecated This only exists to support the deprecated {@link
       *     MediaItem.Builder#setDrmUuid(UUID)}.

methods.name: public Builder setLicenseUri(@Nullable Uri licenseUri)
methods.comment: Sets the optional default DRM license server URI.

methods.name: public Builder setLicenseUri(@Nullable String licenseUri)
methods.comment: Sets the optional default DRM license server URI.

methods.name: public Builder setLicenseRequestHeaders(Map<String, String> licenseRequestHeaders)
methods.comment: Sets the optional request headers attached to DRM license requests.

methods.name: public Builder setMultiSession(boolean multiSession)
methods.comment: Sets whether multi session is enabled.

methods.name: public Builder setForceDefaultLicenseUri(boolean forceDefaultLicenseUri)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether to always use the default DRM license server URI even if the media specifies
       * its own DRM license server URI.

methods.name: public Builder setPlayClearContentWithoutKey(boolean playClearContentWithoutKey)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether clear samples within protected content should be played when keys for the
       * encrypted part of the content have yet to be loaded.

methods.name: public Builder forceSessionsForAudioAndVideoTracks(boolean useClearSessionsForAudioAndVideoTracks)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether a DRM session should be used for clear tracks of type {@link * C#TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO} and {@link C#TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO}. * *

This method overrides what has been set by previously calling {@link * #setForcedSessionTrackTypes(List)}.

methods.name: public Builder setForcedSessionTrackTypes(List<@C.TrackType Integer> forcedSessionTrackTypes)
methods.comment:
* Sets a list of {@link C.TrackType track type} constants for which to use a DRM session even * when the tracks are in the clear. * *

For the common case of using a DRM session for {@link C#TRACK_TYPE_VIDEO} and {@link * C#TRACK_TYPE_AUDIO}, {@link #forceSessionsForAudioAndVideoTracks(boolean)} can be used. * *

This method overrides what has been set by previously calling {@link * #forceSessionsForAudioAndVideoTracks(boolean)}.

methods.name: public Builder setKeySetId(@Nullable byte[] keySetId)
methods.comment:
* Sets the key set ID of the offline license. * *

The key set ID identifies an offline license. The ID is required to query, renew or * release an existing offline license (see {@code DefaultDrmSessionManager#setMode(int * mode,byte[] offlineLicenseKeySetId)}).
